findings.issue: Supabase client uses AbortSignal timeout wrapper but no circuit breaker â€” cannot degrade gracefully when Supabase is slow/failing
findings.impact: A slow Supabase instance causes cascading timeouts across all API routes; no fail-fast or degraded response
findings.fix: Wrap supabase from() calls with executeWithCircuitBreaker or add circuit breaker proxy to createLoggedClient

findings.issue: Worker processors lack per-task timeout â€” webhook-delivery.ts and notification.ts have timeouts but data-retention, cleanup, search-indexer, and reminder do not
findings.impact: A stuck task could block the worker queue indefinitely, stalling all subsequent jobs
findings.fix: Add AbortSignal.timeout() wrapper or BullMQ `timeout` job option to all processor handlers (data-retention, cleanup, search-indexer, reminder)

findings.issue: No bulk endpoints return per-item ok/error results â€” bulk operations fail or succeed as a unit with no partial success
findings.impact: Batch operations (user import, channel creation, message batch operations) provide no granular error feedback; partial failures invisible to user
findings.fix: Standardize bulk response format: { results: [{ ok: boolean, id?: string, error?: string }] } on all bulk endpoints

findings.issue: No consistent pattern for handling partial success in UI â€” operations that affect multiple items show blanket success toast
findings.impact: User sees success confirmation when some items actually failed silently
findings.fix: Add 'summary' response to bulk mutations; show 'X of Y succeeded' toast with failure details when partial results differ

findings.issue: Socket.io has reconnection settings but no exponential backoff or jitter on reconnect attempts
findings.impact: All clients reconnect simultaneously after server restart â€” thundering herd on socket initialization
findings.fix: Add exponential backoff with jitter to socket reconnection: initialDelay=1s, maxDelay=30s, randomizationFactor=0.3

findings.issue: Circuit breaker Prometheus gauge exists (circuitBreakerStatus) but no alert threshold or dashboard configured
findings.impact: Circuit breaker state changes are logged but not actionable â€” operator won't know circuit is open without checking logs
findings.fix: Configure Sentry alert or Prometheus alert rule when circuitBreakerStatus > 0 for any named breaker for > 5 minutes
